intro: Easing Suffering is a quest in Teldrassil centered on delivering emergency aid to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow, who lies stricken by a virulent rot along the road to the Oracle Tree. Players rush Lashwater Salve to her side to ease her agony and bring peace to her failing breath.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.
I do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.
It will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Eralya has stopped responding verbally. Only a weak, gurgled exhale confirms life.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Eralya's breath calms quickly as you help her ingest the salve. She may not survive, but is at relative peace.
